Fresh quadrature recorded outputs, original drivers, all bundled scientific inputs, source hashes, and portable staging adapter.
Packet producer/analyzer, exact preparation and configurations, frozen window, final diagnostics, correction receipts, raw inventory and original producer+patch provenance.
Packet-spectrum signed-bin preparation, weights, kernel inputs, preserved outputs and relative-path replay.
Current final report, top-level claim-scope explanation, strict integrity checker and external-output replay instructions.

raw_recording_policy.description: Multi-gigabyte raw packet traces/checkpoints are not necessary to the exact stationary proof. A regenerable validation repository must disclose the omission and include complete source, initial state, configurations, selector, diagnostics and raw size/hash manifest. Do not label the ZIP a complete raw-data archive unless the raw records themselves are included.
raw_recording_policy.cross_platform_note: Hashes bind the saved executions; regenerated floating-point dynamics need not be bitwise identical across platforms.

scientific_effect: No mathematical or numerical result was refuted by these packaging findings. No new physical-model premise is justified by a portability smoke test.
verification_boundary: R4 saved-job replay verifies 222 saved jobs with physical checks and bridge; it does not recompute 449,698 quadrature leaves. Fresh staging smoke proves portability of one declared pilot only, not a new scientific certification.

replay_environment_hardening.inference_from_source: Historical proof/response scripts use assert. Their child processes should run without Python optimization even if a caller exports PYTHONOPTIMIZE.
replay_environment_hardening.minimal_fix: New wrapper sanitizes child environment with PYTHONOPTIMIZE=0 and PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1. The strict outer checker itself uses explicit exceptions.
replay_environment_hardening.scope: Prevents accidental skipped predicates; no scientific formula or original source change.

smoke.scope: One declared relocated surface N48/Sobol2^18 pilot; no new parameter campaign.
smoke.dependency_environment: Original scientific dependency installation via PYTHONPATH; no scientific input dependency outside bundled upstream staged inputs.
smoke.first_attempt: Default Python lacked scikit-image; failed before numerical calculation. Added explicit preflight before staging.
smoke.note: Dependency-preflight/reporting was added after the successful pilot; final adapter staging and guards were tested separately without redundant quadrature.
smoke.guard_environment_addition: Final adapter sets PYTHONOPTIMIZE=0 and PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 for historical drivers; final staging rechecked without repeating quadrature.
